meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在你查历史记忆时,去 cmem.ai 读取带时间的过往观察(由历次会话自动总结)。做法是先宽泛搜、再用更准的关键词收窄,最后用大白话把要点讲给你听;问“什么时候”时会给对应时间,不直接倾倒原始记录。
howto.when: 当你说“search memory”“check claude-mem”等指令,或问“关于X你记得什么”“上次会话做了什么”,想找项目/任务等之前会话的背景时触发。

say.text: 搜索记忆:关于登录模块,你记得哪些关键决定?
say.note: 它会先宽泛搜、再用精确词查,最后整理成要点回答。

say.text: check claude-mem:上次会话我们确认过哪些任务状态?
say.note: 会按记忆里的时间戳,梳理上次会话的进展。

say.text: 从过去观察里搜:这个文件之前是否提过风险?
say.note: 会提取相关观察,不把完整搜索记录倒给你。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude looks up timestamped observations on cmem.ai that were auto-summarized from earlier sessions. It starts with broad searches, narrows with specific terms, then answers in plain language from what it found, giving the time when asked “when” — without dumping raw records.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to search memory, says “check claude-mem” or “what did we do last session”, asks what Claude remembers about X, or wants old context on a project/task/file.

say_en.text: Search memory: what key decisions do you remember about the login module?
say_en.note: Claude first searches broadly, then narrows, then summarizes.

say_en.text: Check claude-mem: what task status did we confirm last session?
say_en.note: Sets out session progress using memory timestamps.

say_en.text: From past observations, any risks mentioned earlier for this file?
say_en.note: Extracts relevant observations rather than dumping all records.
